podcast.body: The second single from *Attack & Release*, widely considered the band's biggest hit from their pre-superstar era. It is a staple in their live performances and has been extensively used in TV shows, including as the opening theme for the CBC show *The Bridge*. "That's probably the man's biggest hit from their pre-superstar era."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Catching Up With The Black Keys

podcast.body: The second single from the band's fifth studio album, *Attack & Release*, this track is considered their biggest hit from the pre-superstar era. It is almost always performed live and has been widely licensed for TV shows, including serving as the opening theme for the CBC series *The Bridge*. "That's probably the man's biggest hit from their pre-superstar era."
